_status: Every block below is a [TODO: DEFINE] in the recipe. Values were proposed by Claude (2026-10-01) except timeline.bands, which the human supplied in the build request. None is a record.

sponsorship._why: Evidence state (G1 status x family check) -> scorer tier and p. Tier names are the ones role-scorer.mjs reads: soft_sponsorship_tiers = likely/possible/unknown; data/examples/ch11-roles.json uses Proven/Likely/None. Proven is NOT reachable: Ch.7 defines Proven as 'strong, recent filing history and high approval', and the CSV has no filing-year field and approval counts that may be double-counted. Unknown never becomes Avoid/None: the upstream README says an empty sponsorship field does not mean the company does not sponsor.

matched-h1b+in-top-titles.why: company has an H-1B trace AND a title in my family is in its top sponsored titles; 0.6 is the Likely value used in data/examples/ch11-roles.json

matched-h1b+not-in-top-titles.why: company has an H-1B trace but my family is not in the short top-titles list (unknown, not absent); 0.4 is a proposal placed below Likely — no record produced it

matched-h1b+titles-unreadable.why: company has an H-1B trace but the title list could not be parsed, so no family claim is made; same proposal as above

no-h1b-trace.why: no sponsorship evidence either way -> no sponsorship vote is sent (the scorer skips a vote whose p is null)

not-found.why: company name did not match the data; may be a name-match artifact -> no vote

ambiguous.why: more than one row matches; picking one would be a guess -> no vote until a human resolves it

fit._why: My priority order SWE > AI > Cloud, encoded as equal 0.1 steps. The top value is 0.8, not 1.0, because a family preference says nothing about how well I fit a specific posting. This is a preference, not a model judgment of fit.

timeline._why: Planning arithmetic, not immigration advice. days = role start date - EAD start date. The 90-day figure is the post-completion OPT unemployment allowance; a start after it would mean the clock ran out first.

liveness._why: The offline prototype never calls the network. Liveness is ASSUMED open so the scorer can run; it is not checked. G3 stays closed for every role until a human runs the liveness command on the posting URL.

next_action._why: Ch.7 decision rule: Proven and Likely justify targeted application effort; Unknown stays on the list but gets a different kind of attention (resolve the name, find a direct signal); a closed gate or a low composite is a skip.
